whenToUse: Only a year and month are needed, as with card expiry dates.
Months that haven't come yet can't be chosen.
whenNotToUse: A day is needed too (use a date picker).
Only the last few months matter (use a select or chips).
The range of years is very wide.

alternatives.name: Select
alternatives.reason: Choosing only among the last few months.

accessibility: Include the year in month button names ("October 2026") and announce the selection with aria-pressed.
Months that haven't come yet and the next-year button are disabled.
The year display reads the changed year with aria-live.
Put the target year in the previous and next year button names.
